lines: const configuration = { input, inputSha256: sha(raw), locales: ['en', 'zh'], policy: 'real-localStorage-quota-no-mocks' };
const build = Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(assets.sort().map(async path => [path, sha(await readFile(path))])));
const apiServer = await createServer({configFile: false, logLevel: 'error', server: {middlewareMode: true, hmr: false, ws: false}});
server = await preview({configFile: false, base: '/hegemony/', logLevel: 'error', preview: {host: '127.0.0.1', port: 4197, strictPort: true}});
await page.getByRole('button', {name: locale === 'en' ? 'New campaign' : '新战役', exact: true}).click();
const previous = await page.evaluate(key => localStorage.getItem(key), key);
catch (error) {return {saved: false, name: error.name, message: error.message};}
await page.getByRole('button', {name: locale === 'en' ? 'Export' : '导出', exact: true}).click();
for await (const chunk of await download.createReadStream()) chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
runs.push({locale, status: 'passed', userAgent, quota, previousAutosavePreserved: true,
exportedSha256: sha(exported), exportedFilename: download.suggestedFilename(), pageErrors: errors});
console.log(`${locale}: native quota failure; previous autosave preserved; complete long campaign exported identically.`);

await writeFile(output, JSON.stringify({status:'complete', generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), description: 'Production Chromium verification of the documented storage-failure/export fallback using an actual long-campaign save. No Storage mocks, invented campaign history or CPU throttling. This is automated browser evidence, not human or physical low-end-device validation.',
browserVersion: browser.version(), nodeVersion: process.version, fingerprint, build,
inputSha256:sha(raw), normalizedSha256:sha(normalized), day:expected.absoluteDay, phase:expected.phase, runs}, null, 2)+'\n');
if(server) await new Promise((resolve,reject) => server.httpServer.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));

limitations: This checks actual quota recovery on the recorded headless Chromium build, not storage capacity in every browser or a physical low-end device.
Reload restores the previous browser autosave; the large imported campaign remains recoverable through the independent exported file.

The ongoing day-2460 save avoids a terminal battle-report acknowledgement, so the complete imported/exported game state including RNG can be compared without intervening game commands. The initial terminal-save probe stopped at a report overlay and is not counted as a passing export check.
